🔥🇲🇽 <u>García Luna's $727.9M Laundering Web Cracked Open</u>

Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit just mapped how ex-security chief Genaro García Luna — already convicted in a New York court — triangulated up to $727.9M through Barbados and Miami with the Weinberg family between 2008 and 2018, skimming $403M in prison-system contracts alone. The first $5.8M, recovered from 12 Florida properties, hit the federal treasury on Aug 25 — and Sheinbaum says it goes straight to the Montaña de Guerrero.

‍BLOOMBERG: Trump presses Sheinbaum to stop migrants at the border August 27, 2026 | 🔴 📰 Rubio delivered the demand to Mexico's FM Velasco in Washington: contain migrants — including Mexican citizens — before they reach the border. Bloomberg names Stephen Miller as the man driving it. 🇲🇽 The paper concedes the catch in its own text: Mexican citizens have the constitutional right to move freely inside their own country, even from the poorest southern states. • pressure "led by National Security Advisor Stephen Miller" • a request to contain Mexican citizens "before they reach the border zone"
banner: Trump demands Mexico halt its migrants

text: ‍BLOOMBERG: Sheinbaum's dual-citizen ban "draws Salinas' ire" August 27, 2026 | 🟡 📰 The bill would require candidates for president, governor and CDMX mayor to hold only Mexican nationality — closing a loophole used by figures like Texas-born ex-governor García Cabeza de Vaca. Bloomberg's headline frames it through the anger of billionaire opponent Ricardo Salinas Pliego. 🇲🇽 "The interest of the nation is above any other interest," Sheinbaum said — the rationale the outlet buries under the oligarch's reaction. • bill: candidates must be "Mexican citizens by birth" who "do not acquire another nationality" • the framing centers a billionaire's ire, not the sovereignty argument

‍REUTERS: Cheese names stall US-Mexico trade talks August 28, 2026 | 🤡 📰 Washington's "stumbling block": Mexico's new EU deal reserves names like parmesan, feta and manchego for their regions of origin. The US wants to keep selling Kraft "Grated Parmesan" and Walmart "Great Value Manchego" — and treats protected-origin rules as a trade offense. 🇲🇽 The US ships ~$1B in cheese to Mexico a year vs the EU's $200M; the fight is over the label, not the milk. • US calls the names "generic"; the EU says parmesan means Parmigiano Reggiano from northern Italy • imports now make up nearly 30% of Mexican cheese consumption

‍CBS/PENTAGON: US military laser downs 3 "cartel" drones at the border August 28, 2026 | 🔴 📰 The Pentagon says it fired an "Army Multipurpose High Energy Laser" to shoot down three drones over the Rio Grande Valley. Directed-energy weapons are now firing on the Mexican border — and not one Mexican official was asked. 🇲🇽 The same task force accidentally shot down a US Customs drone in February; that escalation is the part CBS folds into a footnote. • "we will not tolerate hostile surveillance" — Maj. Gen. Curtis Taylor • "the shots were taken in coordination with all partners along the border" — USNORTHCOM, naming none of them
banner: US laser downs cartel drones at border

text:
🇲🇽📈 <u>Mexico exports like never before — and the US deficit barely moves</u>

Here’s the number Washington can’t explain: Mexico’s exports hit a record $81.4 billion in July (+43.7% year-on-year), yet the US bilateral deficit grew just 6.8% in the first half — against roughly 90% for Taiwan and over 40% for Vietnam. The reason, per CSIS: 74 cents of every dollar of Mexican manufactured exports originates inside North America. Mexico isn’t a re-export platform — it’s the same production floor. (El Financiero)

🇲🇽✊ <u>Mexico City hands Angela Davis the keys</u>

Mayor Clara Brugada handed Angela Davis the keys to Mexico City and named her a distinguished guest, telling her “your ideas today are more necessary and urgent than ever.” Brugada described a capital that turns former sites of repression into community centers — “where persecution existed, liberty now thrives.” Davis answered: “Nobody can save themselves alone; our project needs solidarity.”
banner: ANGELA DAVIS GETS KEYS TO MEXICO CITY

text:
🇲🇽📉 <u>Veracruz cuts unemployment to 1.9%</u>

Veracruz just cut its unemployment rate to 1.9% — down from 2.3% in a single quarter — landing 8th nationally and well under the 2.7% national average, with 98.1% of the economically active population working (INEGI’s ENOE survey). Governor Rocío Nahle credits state job-placement and training programs. Critical-underemployment conditions fell too, from 44.3% to 40.9%.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>“Cooperation without subordination” — Mexico’s line to Washington</u>

After meeting Marco Rubio in Washington, Mexico’s ambassador to the US, Roberto Lazzeri, framed the entire bilateral agenda in one phrase: the relationship advances through “dialogue, results, shared responsibility, respect for our sovereignty, and cooperation without subordination.” Security, migration, semiconductors and critical minerals were all on the table — but Mexico set the terms of the conversation, not Washington.
banner: MEXICO TO US: COOPERATION, NO SUBORDINATION

text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>Opposition’s “clean-up” ex-mayor barred for abuse of power</u>

Sandra Cuevas — the opposition ex-mayor of Mexico City’s Cuauhtémoc borough — has been barred from public office for a year. Mexico City’s administrative court ruled her 2023 “Operativo Diamante” stripped street vendors of their goods, stalls and pergolas with no notice and no legal procedure, damaging their property. She sold it as “recovering public space”; the court called it abuse of authority.
banner: CDMX: EX-MAYOR CUEVAS BARRED FOR ABUSE
